service.description: Refuses (RESPONSE_LOCKED) when the response answers a FormInvitation, which keeps it as submitted; the FormPublication.eecas.xml rules run the same check before every write of a response and its answers, so org.moqui.impl.ScreenServices.update#FormResponse and delete#FormResponse refuse such a response. A response with no invitation passes.

impl-people P16: the editor of a published form (its purpose's edit permission and organization, mantle.party.FormDefinitions) offers it from now with an access kind (FpaInvited by default, FpaAnonymous, FpaAccount) its purpose's registration admits (mantle.party.FormPurpose accessEnumIds), for the registered publication purpose; refused PUBLICATION_NOT_OFFERED for a kind the purpose does not admit, so a form of a private purpose (People's) is never published to anyone, FORM_NOT_PUBLISHED before its questions are. Once per form and access kind while open. Marketing's publication services build on it (impl-marketing P12).

A new publication of a form (formId) or a change of one (publicationId, at expectedRevision: REVISION_CHANGED naming the current one) by the form's editor (its purpose's edit permission and organization; RECORD_UNAVAILABLE for a form or publication not theirs): the access kind its purpose admits (PUBLICATION_NOT_OFFERED otherwise), the repeat policy, the site, the opening interval (fromDate empty: a draft; INTERVAL_INVALID; FORM_NOT_PUBLISHED before its questions are), the heading, introduction and completion words (no expression, bounded), the context record. A closed publication is not changed (PUBLICATION_CLOSED); one with answers keeps its access kind (PUBLICATION_ANSWERED).

What a respondent sees of a publication (its heading, introduction, the customer-visible questions as of its opening or now with their rules, the completion words) and its state, for its form's editor or reader; changes nothing.
A publication stops taking answers at thruDate (now or later), by its form's editor at the revision read; its answers are kept. A closed one answers closed false.

The form's editor invites recipients ([{partyId, contactPartyId, emailAddress, invitationKey}]) to an open or draft publication of invited recipients (PUBLICATION_NOT_OFFERED otherwise, PUBLICATION_CLOSED when closed), each once by its key; the app's own service sends them and makes their links.

An answer to a publication, for an app's public page that checked the site, the visitor's limits and an invitation's link (invitationId) or a signed-in account (partyId) first: while the publication is open (PUBLICATION_CLOSED), against the form as of now; an unknown or internal field (FIELD_UNKNOWN) and a value for a field its rules hide (FIELD_HIDDEN) are refused, each value of its type (FORM_VALUES_INVALID). The page's request key makes one submission: the same key with the same answers answers the first (alreadyApplied), with other answers REQUEST_KEY_REUSED. An invitation answers once (ALREADY_ANSWERED); an account's publication with the once policy too. The response is kept as submitted.
